purpose: Post-freeze paper diagnostics only; no labels used to modify selection or models.

definitions.neighbor_observation_support: Selected first hops appearing as the second ASN of at least one distinct ordered reference path, divided by all selected first hops.
definitions.distinct_firsthop_coverage: Distinct observed first hops that were selected, divided by all distinct observed first hops.
definitions.path_weighted_firsthop_coverage: Distinct ordered reference paths whose first hop was selected, divided by all distinct ordered reference paths.
definitions.selected_observed_neighbor_representatio: Selected and observed first hops with at least one admitted augmented path, divided by all selected and observed first hops.
definitions.ordered_support_on_reference_pairs: Admitted unique ordered paths exactly matching a reference path, divided by admitted unique ordered paths whose source/destination pair occurs in the references.
definitions.unsupported_is_not_false: A path absent from finite reference observations is unobserved; not proven unreal or forwarding-invalid.
definitions.no_reversal: No path reversal, completion, or graph inference used in this audit.
definitions.pair_balanced_firsthop_coverage: For each reference source/destination pair, fraction of its distinct reference paths whose first hop was selected; then arithmetic mean over reference pairs.
definitions.pair_balanced_frontier_prefix_coverage: For each reference pair, fraction of distinct paths whose selected root and (when that root was expanded and the reference contains at least three ASes) selected next hop match the plan; arithmetic mean over reference pairs. Stopped roots need only firsthop match; two-AS reference paths need only selected root. This diagnostic describes planned frontier choice, not full path feasibility.
definitions.unsupported_novelty_metric: Support after excluding previously known paths is not computed or reported by this audit.
